risks.title: EV Transition Execution and Demand
risks.score_rationale: GM has invested heavily in Ultium platform, battery JVs and EV models. Slower-than-expected EV adoption, pricing pressure from Tesla and Chinese OEMs, and battery cost trajectory directly impact profitability and capex returns.
risks.summary: Slower EV adoption, intense pricing competition and battery cost volatility could impair Ultium investments and delay the path to EV profitability.

risks.title: China Market Deterioration
risks.score_rationale: GM's China JVs (SAIC-GM, Wuling) have moved from material profit contributor to losses amid local EV brand competition. 2024 saw GM take ~USD 5bn in China-related charges/impairments.
risks.summary: Continued share loss to local Chinese EV OEMs and JV restructuring costs could result in further impairments and reduced equity income.

risks.title: Cruise / Autonomous Driving
risks.score_rationale: Following the 2023 Cruise pedestrian incident, GM has wound down robotaxi operations and refocused Cruise on personal AV, taking material restructuring charges and regulatory scrutiny.
risks.summary: Autonomous driving technology delays, regulatory actions and Cruise restructuring costs could pressure earnings and reduce strategic optionality.

risks.title: Labor Relations and UAW
risks.score_rationale: The 2023 UAW agreement raised structural labor costs by an estimated USD 9.3bn over the contract. Future strikes, organization at battery JVs, or wage spirals would compress margins.
risks.summary: Higher UAW labor costs, potential strikes and unionization of battery JVs raise the structural cost base and reduce competitiveness versus non-union OEMs.

risks.title: Trade Policy, Tariffs and IRA
risks.score_rationale: GM imports significant volumes from Mexico, Korea and Canada. Tariff changes, USMCA renegotiation and IRA EV credit eligibility (battery sourcing) materially affect product economics.
risks.summary: New tariffs on Mexico/Canada/Korea imports and changes to IRA EV tax credit rules could raise costs and reduce EV demand.

risks.title: Recall, Warranty and Product Liability
risks.score_rationale: GM has booked large warranty charges in 2024 related to L87 V8 engines and EV battery recalls (Bolt). Item 1A flags warranty and recall costs as a principal risk.
risks.summary: Large-scale recalls, warranty campaigns and product liability litigation could materially impact earnings and reputation.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Privacy
risks.score_rationale: Connected vehicles generate large volumes of telematics data; GM faced 2024 lawsuits and FTC scrutiny over driving data sharing with insurers.
risks.summary: Cybersecurity incidents on connected vehicles and litigation over telematics data sharing could result in fines, settlements and brand damage.
